openwrtfi.description: Read-only ubus access for the OpenWrtFi controller's poll loop (install on APs as /usr/share/rpcd/acl.d/openwrtfi.json, for the dedicated read-only rpcd user in Config.nodes[].username). Write actions never use this user — see rpcd-acl-openwrtfi-admin.json, granted to the logged-in dashboard admin's own session instead.
